title: Ongoing hybrid program: semen extraction during abductions

tellings.quote: Whitley Strieber who talk about you know semen extraction taking place during alien abductions.

plain: Some people who say aliens abducted them describe semen being taken from them during the abduction, which is read as a sign of an ongoing program to breed human-alien hybrids. Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher with a PhD who studies psychic phenomena, mentions this to Michels, pointing to people such as Whitley Strieber, whom he names as one of those who talk about it.
